title: Loyalty points: deduplicating purchase events on the wrong key
name: Loyalty points dedup

questions.prompt: After the Black Friday rush, support got a wave of tickets from members whose points balance was double or triple what their orders justify. Every case we checked lines up with a "publish timed out" warning from checkout at the time of the order. Redeliveries after consumer crashes are handled fine, and the dedup store is working (it reports hits). Fix the points consumer so the tests pass.
